speaker: Doctor

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Smooth polylobulated mass in the left breast.

speaker: Doctor
text:
A smooth, polylobulated mass is highly characteristic of a benign fibroadenoma. Given the rapid growth, I will order a biopsy to confirm the diagnosis.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Image shows leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The biopsy showing leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth is the classic histological hallmark of a phyllodes tumor. I have sufficient evidence to make a diagnosis.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes tumor
